entries.subject: Placement

Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3181.2 +/- 506.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3181.2 +/- 506.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.4007 +/- 0.0177 mas (same row, RUWE 1.32), 22.7 standard errors, is not used. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 95.1 +/- 15.4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V495 Cyg: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 95.1 +/- 15.4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 66,161,070 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 380, Name='V495 Cyg', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 2055809495218465152: 4 G-band harmonics of a 6.7173915197932965 d period, peak-to-peak 0.341 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.04 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,375 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.977 +/- 0.055 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecdd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,375 K and log g 2.02 (u1 0.527, u2 0.212): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
